description: EU VAT number validation via VIES. Checks whether an EU VAT number is valid and returns the registered name and address. Use the two-letter EU country code (e.g. IE) and the VAT number without the country prefix. An invalid number returns valid: false; if the member state's service is down, the call fails with 502. Price $0.020 per call (x402: USDC on Base or Solana).

country.description: Two-letter EU country code (Greece is EL, Northern Ireland is XI)

number.description: VAT number without the country code
